shoe_lettering.lateral_surface: Black high-top, blue outlined side emblem with internal decoration, purple accent, cream midsole, black outsole. Preserve the specific external lateral design of each shoe; do not mirror or invent missing decoration.

DONG outer lateral blue-outlined interior pattern requires explicit opposite-facing image review

reference_policy.portrait: Identity origin only; consult when establishing or revising the animated design.
reference_policy.legacy_character_sheet: Inherited design source, not a single-subject video frame.
reference_policy.shoe_photos: Shoe detail only; never transfer background or photographic rendering.
reference_policy.expression_and_pose_sheets: Performance only; cannot redefine geometry or outfit.
reference_policy.candidate_masters: Review and draft generation only until actually selected.

approval_policy.notes: Record the user's actual selection or documented approval. Do not fabricate approval from script validation.
